login.intro: Enter your email address and we'll send you a link to sign in. No password needed.

hero.tagline: Your favourites and dashboards, self-hosted and in one place.

dashboards.title: Dashboards
dashboards.description: Build start pages with links, sections and navigation trees right in the browser.

favourites.title: Favourites
favourites.description: Keep all your bookmarks in one tree of folders and links.

karakeep.title: Karakeep and Linkwarden apps
karakeep.description: Save links from the Karakeep and Linkwarden browser extensions and mobile apps.

apps.intro: Connect apps such as the Karakeep or Linkwarden browser extension or mobile app, or a Memos app like MoeMemos, to your favourites and notes. Each connection gets its own API key and only sees the folder you choose for it, and for Karakeep and Memos the notes of the category you choose.
apps.emptyText: Connect a Karakeep or Linkwarden app to save links straight into a folder of your favourites, or a Memos app to write your notes on the go. The app only sees the folder or category you choose.
apps.revokeText: “{{name}}” will stop working right away. This can't be undone; to connect the app again, create a new key.
apps.deleteText: “{{name}}” will be removed from your connected apps.

form.title: Connect app
form.text: The app gets an API key that only works for the folder you choose. You can change the folder and the category later, but not the name, the app or the expiry.
form.name: Name
form.memosHint: For Memos apps like MoeMemos. They see only notes, no favourites.
form.rootHint: The app sees and saves only into this folder and the folders inside it.
form.expiryInvalid: Choose a date in the future.
form.rootCategoryHint: Text bookmarks from the app are saved as notes in this category. The app sees the notes of this category and its subcategories.
form.rootCategoryHintMemos: New memos from the app are saved as notes in this category. The app sees the notes of this category and its subcategories.

secret.title: App connected
secret.text: Enter the server address and the API key in the app for “{{name}}”.
secret.once: Copy the API key now. It won't be shown again.

editForm.title: Edit connected app
editForm.text: The app keeps its API key and sees the new folder and category with its next request.
editForm.inactive: This app is no longer active.

import.title: Import bookmarks
import.intro: Bring your bookmarks over from Karakeep, Linkwarden or a browser, once. Folders, tags and dates are kept, and Karakeep text bookmarks become notes. Links and notes that are already saved are skipped.
import.karakeepHint: From Karakeep, use the JSON export: it keeps your lists, the HTML export doesn't.
import.folderHint: Folders of the file are created in this folder. Folders that already exist there with the same name are used.
import.skipDuplicates: Skip links and notes that are already saved

errors.invalidFile: This file isn't a valid {{format}} export.
errors.tooLarge: The file is too large. It can have at most 10 MB.
errors.invalidFolder: Choose one of your folders to import into.
errors.invalidCategory: Choose one of your categories to import notes into.

report.duplicates_one: {{count}} link was already in your favourites
report.duplicates_other: {{count}} links were already in your favourites

report.tooLargeNotes_one: {{count}} note was too large to import
report.tooLargeNotes_other: {{count}} notes were too large to import

import.categoryHint: Karakeep text bookmarks become notes. Lists with notes are created as categories in this category. Categories that already exist there with the same name are used.

passkeys.emptyText: Add a passkey to sign in with one tap next time. Each device or password manager gets its own passkey.
